sources.verified_angle_summary: Saudi Arabia's Social Development Bank (SDB) announced the launch of its AI-powered "Smart Collection" service and the "Noura" smart assistant chatbot during the Saudi Digital Exhibition at LEAP 2026. The AI Smart Collection system analyzes customer data to personalize communication and improve collection efficiency across multiple channels, offering accurate and proactive interactions. The Noura chatbot aims to facilitate access to SDB services, with over one million beneficiaries already utilizing the service, and 50% of the bank's services being completed through it. This development represents a significant step in SDB's digital transformation and its adoption of AI to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency in the financial sector. The story is verified as a concrete product launch and operational deployment at LEAP 2026, distinct from existing coverage.
